scope_note: The archive site of the 国民民主党 of May 2018 to September 2020 (旧・国民民主党), its report dated 7 May 2018 of its founding convention; an earlier organization with the same name, kept apart from the 2025 election-list observation.

rows.text: The archive site of the 国民民主党 of May 2018 to September 2020 reports that on the afternoon of the 7th the party held its founding convention in Tokyo and decided its platform, rules and officers ('国民民主党は７日午後、東京都内で設立大会を開催し、新党の綱領・規約・役員人事などを決定した').

rows.role_title: 共同代表 — co-representative of the 国民民主党 of May 2018 to September 2020 (旧・国民民主党; an earlier organization with the same name; claims only)
rows.text: It reports a proposal, approved by applause, that under the rules' supplementary provision allowing co-representatives ('新党決定に当たっては共同代表を置くことができる'), with the first representative's term ending at the end of September 2018 ('最初の代表の任期は本年９月末日'), the party's representative at the start be the co-representatives 大塚耕平 and 玉木雄一郎 ('大塚耕平参院議員、…玉木雄一郎衆院議員による共同代表がふさわしい').

rows.role_title: 共同代表 — co-representative of the 国民民主党 of May 2018 to September 2020 (旧・国民民主党; an earlier organization with the same name; claims only)
rows.text: It reports that 大塚耕平 and 玉木雄一郎, chosen as co-representatives, took the stage and gave their inaugural greetings ('共同代表に選出された大塚耕平、玉木雄一郎両代表が登壇し、就任のあいさつを行った').
